pattern.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. '*.ts', '**/*.json', or 'src/**/*.spec.ts'.

path.description: Absolute path on the target daemon's file system of the directory to search in. Required. There is no implicit default — the model must always state the search root. Relative paths are rejected; results are reported as absolute paths.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 1000.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive timeout in seconds. Defaults to 60 (1 minute).
